rationale: The parties have clarified the economics and identified a narrow compromise space, but the core conflict remains unresolved: employee/state actors insist on no closures and no compulsory redundancies, while management, investors, and the family still keep both as live options. Positions have hardened over the last two rounds with little substantive movement, so further open-ended rounds are likely to circle unless the process is actively steered into a structured mediation.
